items.headline: Pac-12 matchup features Texas State playing Washington State

items.headline: Davian Jackson's late TD run lifts Texas State over Fresno State 37-35
items.description: — Brad Jackson threw three touchdown passes, and Davian Jackson had a 2-yard touchdown run with a minute left to give Texas State a 37-35 victory over Fresno State on Saturday.

items.headline: Texas State steamrolls Oregon State with 600 yards, 5 TDs on the ground in 42-21 win
items.description: — Torrance Burgess Jr. ran for 196 yards and a touchdown, Davian Jackson ran for three scores and surpassed 100 yards rushing, and Texas State rolled past Oregon State 42-21 on Saturday night.
